mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_shop_member WHERE system_account = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_agent agent WHERE agent.status <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount), 0) FROM dms_commission_record WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_commission_record WHERE status = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(withdraw_amount), 0) FROM dms_withdraw_record WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_withdraw_record WHERE status = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(finance.net_pay_amount), 0) AS totalReceiptAmount, COALESCE(SUM(finance.product_cost + finance.bonus_amount + finance.company_share_amount), 0) AS totalPayoutAmount, COALESCE(SUM(finance.product_cost), 0) AS totalProductCostAmount, COALESCE(SUM(finance.bonus_amount), 0) AS totalBonusPayoutAmount, COALESCE(SUM(finance.company_share_amount), 0) AS totalCompanyShareAmount, COALESCE(SUM(finance.company_profit), 0) AS totalProfitAmount FROM dms_order_finance finance INNER JOIN dms_shop_order shop_order ON shop_order.id = finance.order_id WHERE shop_order.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND shop_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT item.product_id AS productId, item.product_name AS productName, MAX(item.product_cover) AS productCover, COUNT(DISTINCT item.order_id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(item.quantity), 0) AS salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(item.total_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM dms_shop_order_item item INNER JOIN dms_shop_order shop_order ON shop_order.id = item.order_id WHERE shop_order.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND shop_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND shop_order.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY item.product_id, item.product_name ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, salesQuantity DESC, item.product_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT shop_order.receiver_province AS regionName, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM dms_shop_order shop_order INNER JOIN dms_shop_member member ON member.user_id = shop_order.user_id WHERE member.system_account = 0 AND shop_order.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND shop_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND shop_order.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND NULLIF(TRIM(shop_order.receiver_province), '') IS NOT NULL AND shop_order.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM dms_shop_order candidate WHERE candidate.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.user_id = shop_order.user_id AND candidate.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND candidate.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND NULLIF(TRIM(candidate.receiver_province), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY candidate.pay_time DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY shop_order.receiver_province ORDER BY memberCount DESC, shop_order.receiver_province ASC

SELECT DATE(shop_order.pay_time) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(shop_order.total_amount - COALESCE(refund.product_refund_amount, 0), 0)), 0) AS performanceAmount FROM dms_shop_order shop_order LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, COALESCE(SUM(product_refund_amount), 0) AS product_refund_amount FROM dms_finance_refund GROUP BY order_id ) refund ON refund.order_id = shop_order.id WHERE shop_order.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND shop_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND shop_order.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND shop_order.pay_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(shop_order.pay_time) ORDER BY DATE(shop_order.pay_time)

SELECT agent.agent_level AS agentLevel, COUNT(*) AS memberCount FROM dms_agent agent WHERE agent.status <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_member member WHERE member.user_id = agent.user_id AND member.system_account = 1 ) GROUP BY agent.agent_level ORDER BY agent.agent_level

SELECT withdraw.id, withdraw.withdraw_no AS withdrawNo, COALESCE(agent.agent_name, withdraw.account_name) AS agentName, withdraw.account_name AS accountName, withdraw.withdraw_amount AS withdrawAmount, withdraw.create_time AS createTime FROM dms_withdraw_record withdraw LEFT JOIN dms_agent agent ON agent.id = withdraw.agent_id WHERE withdraw.status = 0 ORDER BY withdraw.create_time DESC, withdraw.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, agent_name AS agentName, order_no AS orderNo, bonus_type AS bonusType, commission_amount AS commissionAmount, status, create_time AS createTime FROM dms_commission_record ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
